case_title.quote: NARENDER SINGH & ORS. v. STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH

number_of_accused.quote: Out of 7 accused, A2 to A6 are the appellants before us
number_of_accused.reason: Body says seven accused; the headnote's six excludes the juvenile. Value omits that.

accused_gender.quote: A5 was holding a sword, A6 was holding a Farsa
accused_gender.reason: Accused are treated as male, though not explicit. Acceptable inference.

accused_age.reason: No age of any accused is given.

accused_caste.reason: Caste not stated; only 'same community' is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: the name of deceased Ram Bhuvan, son of Sunder Lal Sharma

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Known to each other; old enmity (deceased was village Sarpanch)
accused_victim_relationship.quote: "due to old enmity, attacked with sharp weapon with intention to kill"
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment shows prior enmity and known accused, not strangers.

offence_category.quote: convicted the appellants accused for the offence under Section 302

statutory_provisions.quote: offence under Section 302 read with Sections 148 and 149 IPC

weapon.quote: A5 was holding a sword, A6 was holding a Farsa, A2 was having an axe while A1, A3 and A4 were having lathis

evidence_type.quote: weapons which were recovered at the instance of the appellants
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical and recovery evidence all relied upon.

confession.reason: No confession; only Section 27 recovery statements.

trial_court_outcome.quote: The appellants were imposed with the punishment of life imprisonment.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Conviction and sentence confirmed by the High Court
high_court_outcome.quote: The Division Bench having confirmed the conviction and sentence imposed on the appellants
high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court did decide the appeal, confirming conviction.

final_outcome.quote: we do not find any merit in these appeals and the same are dismissed

neutral_facts.quote: P.W.3, 6 and the deceased were sitting and conversing
neutral_facts.reason: Consistent with facts and reveals no outcome.

physical_harm.quote: as many as 8 injuries were noted on the body of the deceased. Out of the 8 injuries, injury Nos. 4,5, 6 and 7 were noted as grievous

premeditation_planning.correct_value: No finding on premeditation; prosecution case only that armed accused arrived and threatened the deceased

motive.quote: "due to old enmity, attacked with sharp weapon with intention to kill"

key_evidence_accepted.quote: supported by the evidence of the two eye-witness which was fully corroborated by other witnesses

witness_credibility.quote: evidence of P.W.3 as an eye witness was cogent in every respect

post_offence_conduct.reason: No real discussion of post-offence conduct.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence 27 June 1997; trial court date not stated; High Court 07.09.2006; Supreme Court 29.09.2015
trial_duration.quote: Judgment and Order dated 07.09.2006 of the High Court
trial_duration.reason: 07.09.2006 is the High Court date, not the trial judgment.

legal_representation.quote: Tripurari Ray, Dhirendra Singh Parmar... for the Appellants. Arjun Garg, Manish Yadav, Mishra Saurabh, Advs., for the Respondent.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel correctly listed; stray 'B' is a margin marker.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Delay in forwarding Express Report to Illaka Magistrate (received 1:20 p.m., 30 June 1997); held not prejudicial
procedural_irregularity.quote: even though the delay was quite apparent by virtue of Exhibit 08
procedural_irregularity.reason: Court noted a delay in forwarding the FIR report.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court convicted and sentenced to life; High Court confirmed; Supreme Court dismissed appeals
appeal_history.quote: convicted the appellants accused for the offence under Section 302
appeal_history.reason: Trial court entry wrongly says 'confirmed'; it convicted.

prosecution_argument.quote: the arrest of the appellants effected on 28th June, 1997 and the subsequent seizure

defence_argument.quote: the FIR was ante-dated and that the appellants were falsely implicated

legal_principle_applied.quote: Every such delay is not fatal unless prejudice to the accused is shown.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Pala Singh v. State of Punjab (1972) 2 SCC 640

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court gave no sentencing reasoning; value restates conviction reasoning.
